_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The shepherds came with haste to see this thing.
Glory to God in the highest!
They found Mary and Joseph, and the child lying in a manger.
Glory to God in the highest!
The mercy of God our Savior has appeared.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: The shepherds run through the dark, breathless, toward a word they can hardly believe.
Glory to God in the highest!
And there it is — an ordinary stable, a young family, a child asleep in the straw.
Glory to God in the highest!
Not because we earned it, but because of God's mercy, salvation is born among us.
Glory to God in the highest!
So treasure it, like Mary did; ponder it in your heart and carry it home.
Glory to God in the highest, and peace on earth!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The shepherds hurry to the manger.
Glory to God in the highest!
Mercy, not merit, has brought us a Savior.
Glory to God in the highest!
Treasure it; ponder it; carry it home.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.
